title: SLEEPING MACHINES
why: His g-25: Yes, a few more sleepers. A deterministic fifth of eligible sentries and bulwarks begin asleep away from ascend spots. Watch: a sleeper waking next to loot can feel like the removed mimics; watch for wakes he calls cheap, and that sleepers read as asleep from a distance.
now: Sleeping machines stay still and dark until noise, a hit or a close step wakes them, with a 0.6 second charge beat before firing.
